title: LLM-Based Test Generation: Information Sources, Generation Strategies, and Quality Evidence
year_venue: 2026 arXiv preprint v1 (submitted 2026-10-04); no peer-reviewed venue verified
datasets: No experimental benchmark or model dataset. This is a structured narrative survey based on 95 curated source records through 2026-09-29, including seven surveys/roadmaps and 88 primary-method/benchmark/empirical/historical records. SWT-Bench and TC-Bench are discussed as related benchmark examples, not evaluated.
artifact_url: https://github.com/dududuck00/llm-test-generation-survey (public literature register, search/verification notes, supplemental provenance, manuscript source and figure build scripts).
license: No repository-wide license; paper arXiv perpetual non-exclusive; bundled template retains its own license.
input_setting: Not an empirical model input/output study. The paper proposes a conceptual framework for how test artifacts are constructed and how their quality is evidenced; it distinguishes repository tests, requirements tests, oracles, API/GUI sequences, fuzzers and bug-reproduction tests.
reproduction_grade: Not applicable as an experiment; conceptual survey only.
concept_hook: High related-work synthesis around information provenance, oracle evidence, and bug reproduction.
limitation: Narrative survey, not SLR; 95-record preliminary corpus, no dual-screening, full coding, IRR or reproduced performance.
